Product Name:

GDF-8 Prodomain Peptide — 23-mer

(Growth Differentiation Factor-8)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C130H222N42O32
  • Molecular Weight: 2885.42 g/mol
  • Sequence: Trp-Arg-Gln-Asn-Thr-Arg-Tyr-Ser-Arg-Ile-Glu-Ala-Ile-Lys-Ile-Gln-Ile-Leu-Ser-Lys-Leu-Arg-Leu-NH2 (WRQNTRYSRIEAIKIQILSKLRL-NH₂)
  • Structure Class: Synthetic peptide (23-amino-acid prodomain fragment)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

GDF-8 Prodomain Peptide is a synthetic 23-amino-acid sequence modeled on a defined region of the GDF-8 prodomain. It is supplied as a lyophilized powder for use exclusively in controlled in vitro research by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:

GDF-8 Prodomain Peptide is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • In vitro evaluation of peptide–protein binding interactions in defined assay systems
  • Development of analytical assay models involving prodomain-derived peptide sequences
  • Comparative analysis of sequence variants under controlled experimental conditions
  • Examination of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay environments
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling protocols
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

GDF-8 Prodomain Peptide is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
